cnn.what: tempocnn_np.predict rows (softmax over the 256 tempo classes), every patch

hpcp.what: hpcp_frames rows (A = 440), first frames of the file

key44100_edges.what: first and last samples of the 44.1 kHz signal the key reads

mel.what: tempocnn_np.mel_bands rows, first frames of the file

peaks.what: per HPCP frame: count (int32), then count x (frequency, magnitude, whitened magnitude)

tempo11025_edges.what: first and last samples of the 11.025 kHz signal the tempo reads
